message:
Capabilities:
[
 {
  "name": "Time off",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Requests",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Who (person; required)",
     "Type (choice; required; choices: Vacation, Sick, Personal)",
     "From (date; required)",
     "To (date; required)",
     "Days (computed; worked out: To − From + 1)",
     "Note (long_text)",
     "Status (step)",
     "Balance after (computed; worked out: Left in Balances for the same Who if Status is approved or taken, otherwise Left in Balances for the same Who − Days)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Submitted (start)",
     "Approved",
     "Declined (exit)",
     "Taken (last)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Balances",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Who (person; required)",
     "Year (number)",
     "Days a year (days)",
     "Used (days)",
     "Left (computed; worked out: Days a year − Used + the Who's leave entries added up)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Holidays",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Date (date; required)",
     "Holiday (text; required)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Leave entries",
    "kind": "ledger",
    "columns": [
     "Who (person; required)",
     "Days (days; required)",
     "Note (text)",
     "Balance after (days)",
     "Reverses (link; links to Leave entries)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Time off admins: every row",
   "Everyone: their own rows",
   "Everyone (holidays): every row",
   "Managers: their team's rows",
   "Everyone on Leave entries: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "Requests go to the person’s manager.",
   "When a request is approved, tell the person and Lena.",
   "When a request is declined, tell the person and Lena."
  ]
 }
]

Sentences:
1. When a request is approved, add an entry to Leave entries for the person with its Days as a negative amount, so the days come off their balance.
